name: Wuxi Smart Auto-Control Engineering Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Smart Auto-Control Engineering Co., Ltd., established in 2001 and headquartered in Wuxi, China, specializes in the entire lifecycle of process control valves, encompassing their research, development, manufacturing, sales, and service within the Chinese market. The company boasts a diverse product portfolio, including single seat sleeve, sleeve control, butterfly, ball, anti-corrosion, and specialized material valves. Beyond production, it also provides crucial repair and maintenance services for these valve systems. Its high-performance products are extensively utilized across various major sectors, such as petrochemicals, steel, energy, metallurgy, foundational infrastructure, and environmental protection.
